role: Single decision point for the Foster (1998) training-monotony warning: raised only when weekly monotony > 2.0 AND strain > 1600, shared by Load & Trajectory, Training Load screen and TrainingAdviceGate.
types: FosterMonotonyWarning: enum — namespace for the monotony-warning rule
toplevel: Thresholds read from RecoveryScoreConstants.Training.monotonyThreshold (2.0, Constants+RecoveryScore.swift:230) and strainThreshold (1600, :237).

units.does: Computes Foster monotony/strain over the 7 days ending at referenceDate from a date->load map and returns whether the warning is raised; false when no computation is possible (no load at all or calendar failure).

branches.effect: nil: returns false; non-nil: delegates to isRaised(_:)

flags.text: docs/FLOWCHART.md says the Foster banner shows when monotony > 2.0, leaving out the strain > 1600 condition this function also requires (docs/FEATURES.md:37 states both).
